qualification_boundary: Exact-head CI qualifies catalog integrity, authority pinning, coverage, hard-mass metadata, bounded pairwise/risk selection and support-only diff. Each physics case remains separately executable/admissible only with owner evidence.
defect_policy: Do not repair source defects in F-TB09; route any discovered defect to a separate owner workunit.
close_condition: The branch HEAD must equal the successful F-TB09 workflow run head SHA. No commit may be added after the green run without rerunning exact-head CI.
